items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Then you did some Luis Gasca session... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I remember that session.

ctx.x: Really? On the Gil Evans date?
Um-hmm. Yeah, because we were out looking for that. I said, I got to hear that one. Then Gary McFarland, and then Luis Gasca.
Yeah, I never got paid for that Gary McFarland date. But guess who did?
